title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature matters as it improves security by automatically redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS, ensuring encrypted communication between the client and server. It does this by checking the request protocol and redirecting to the corresponding HTTPS URL. This enhances the overall security of the framework
testCases: Test HTTP request redirect to HTTPS
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all HTTP requests are automatically redirected to their corresponding HTTPS URLs without affecting existing HTTPS requests
reason: Enhancing security is a high-impact improvement that aligns with the framework's focus on stability and security
